description: An EXIT PROGRAM statement followed by another statement in its sequence — a COBOL-2002 relaxation of a COBOL-85 restriction, QUOTED from ISO/IEC 1989:2002 Annex F.2 item 50: "EXIT PROGRAM allowed as other than last statement. EXIT PROGRAM is allowed to appear as other than the last statement in a consecutive sequence of imperative statements." COBOL-85 is the edition a 2002 Annex F.2 'formerly' statement describes: the owner's decision of 2026-10-31 (kb/Work PB4305) makes the F.2 statements the rule for the 85 edge, as D-SIGN2 (item 124) and PB3683 (item 123) did; GnuCOBOL -std=cobol85 accepts some of them as dialect leniency, which rule 1 places below the ISO text. Gated in ONE place, VersionConformancePass.ParseArm.VisitExitStatement, the EXIT PROGRAM arm (kb/Work PB4305; VCR row 7.47).
display: an EXIT PROGRAM statement followed by another statement in its sequence
vcr: VCR Table 7 row 7.47 - the 2002 Annex F.2 relaxations of COBOL-85 restrictions (item 50)
